codeReview.summary: Added 9 error path tests to registration.rs (from 2 to 11 total), all passing. Tests thoroughly cover the three RegistrationState variants with invalid/unexpected inputs: wrong frame types, empty payloads, missing bytes, out-of-order state transitions, and ID-zero edge case. All three validation assertions (VAL-REG-001, VAL-REG-002, VAL-REG-003) are fully satisfied. Production code was not modified — only test additions. Tests are well-structured with clear names that describe the scenario, and each test validates both the returned action and the resulting state.
